title: Prepare an image reference/character sheet first (you can generate it with GPT…
content:
Prepare an image reference/character sheet first (you can generate it with GPT 2.0/ChatGPT) and use it as the Seedance character reference.  
Use Claude to draft a Seedance prompt in this template: character [name/upload reference sheet], scene [what happens], location [place], mood [atmosphere], duration [seconds], scene changes every [X] seconds.
